basic_details.job_title: HP High Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The High Court of Himachal Pradesh, Shimla, will fill 5 posts of Stenographer (Group-C) (Mode-B) through a departmental recruitment open to Graduate Junior Scale Stenographers of the High Court and the District Judiciary of H.P. An addendum dated 18 November 2026 adds 2 posts to the 3 posts advertised on 24 August 2026. Applications go offline, through proper channel, to the Recruitment Section of the High Court on the prescribed format, on or before 03 December 2026. Applications received after the due date are not entertained.

qualification.details: Graduate Junior Scale Stenographers working in the High Court and Graduate Junior Scale Stenographers working in the District Judiciary in H.P. Experience: one year in case of Junior Scale Stenographers of the High Court of H.P., and three years in case of Junior Scale Stenographers from the District Judiciary. Experience is calculated up to the last date of application, as required by the R&P Rules, 2015. Speed of 100 W.P.M. in English Stenography, with accurate transcription of the matter dictated within a period of 5 times the time allotted for dictation. Typing speed in English of 50 W.P.M. on computers, for which a separate test shall be held.

selection_process: Recruitment is on the basis of a limited competitive proficiency test as per Schedule-IV (Part-H) of the R&P Rules
English Stenography at 100 W.P.M.; transcription within 5 times the dictation time. Typing test: ten (10) minutes
English at 50 W.P.M. on computers. Only 10% mistakes are allowed in the transcribed dictated matter and the typed matter. Candidates committing more than 10% mistakes are declared unqualified.

content_sections.heading: HP High Court Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: High Court of Himachal Pradesh, Shimla
Pay Level 11 i.e. Rs. 38,500-1,22,700/- of the Pay Matrix
Graduate Junior Scale Stenographers of the High Court or District Judiciary of H.P., with experience
Establishment of the High Court of H.P., Shimla

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The recruitment is departmental: applications are invited through proper channel from eligible officials of the High Court Registry and the District Judiciary of H.P. The application must be made on the prescribed format attached to the addendum, "Offline Application Form for the Post(s) of Stenographer – High Court (Mode-B)", with the requisite documents. High Court officials: the notice is forwarded through the Principal Private Secretary to Hon'ble the Chief Justice, and candidates may submit the offline application with requisite documents to the Recruitment Section on or before the last date. District Judiciary officials: the District & Sessions Judges circulate the notice in their Civil & Sessions Divisions; the offline applications with requisite documents may be dispatched or forwarded to the Registry immediately before the last date, after verification of the details filled by the candidates. Address: Recruitment Section, Registry of the High Court of Himachal Pradesh, Shimla-171 001. The form asks for name (in capital letters), father's or husband's name, date of birth, gender, present designation, date of initial appointment with designation (Regular/Contract), date of joining as Jr. Scale Stenographer (Regular), experience as Jr. Scale Stenographer (Regular) as on 03.12.2026 in years and months, place of posting, educational qualification, correspondence address with PIN code, mobile number and email address. All fields must be filled, and the form carries a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Graduate Junior Scale Stenographers working in the High Court and Graduate Junior Scale Stenographers working in the District Judiciary in H.P. Experience: one year in case of Junior Scale Stenographers of the High Court of H.P., and three years in case of Junior Scale Stenographers from the District Judiciary. Experience is calculated up to the last date of application, as required by the R&P Rules, 2015. Speed of 100 W.P.M. in English Stenography, with accurate transcription of the matter dictated within a period of 5 times the time allotted for dictation. Typing speed in English of 50 W.P.M. on computers, for which a separate test shall be held.

rows.pay: Pay Level 11 i.e. Rs. 38,500-1,22,700/- of the Pay Matrix

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Recent passport size photograph, duly self-attested, pasted on the form. Self-attested copies of 10th and essential qualification certificates. Self-attested photocopies of documents from 10th onwards.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Recruitment is on the basis of a limited competitive proficiency test as per Schedule-IV (Part-H) of the R&P Rules, 2015. Dictation test: ten (10) minutes, English Stenography at 100 W.P.M.; transcription within 5 times the dictation time. Typing test: ten (10) minutes, English at 50 W.P.M. on computers. Only 10% mistakes are allowed in the transcribed dictated matter and the typed matter. Candidates committing more than 10% mistakes are declared unqualified.

faq.question: Q1. How many Stenographer posts are in the HP High Court addendum 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 posts of Stenographer (Group-C) (Mode-B): 3 advertised earlier and 2 additional posts, filled through a common recruitment process.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted on or before 03 December 2026; applications received after the due date are not entertained.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for HP High Court Stenographer (Mode-B)?
faq.answer: Graduate Junior Scale Stenographers working in the High Court of H.P. with one year of experience, or in the District Judiciary in H.P. with three years of experience, applying through proper channel.

faq.question: Q4. What shorthand and typing speed is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need 100 W.P.M. in English Stenography and an English typing speed of 50 W.P.M. on computers.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of HP High Court Stenographer (Mode-B)?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level 11 i.e. Rs. 38,500-1,22,700/- of the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed offline form, attach self-attested copies of 10th and essential qualification certificates, and send it through proper channel to the Recruitment Section of the High Court by 03 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by a limited competitive proficiency test under Schedule-IV (Part-H) of the R&P Rules, 2015, with dictation and typing tests of ten minutes each; more than 10% mistakes means the candidate is declared unqualified.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to apply again if I applied against the notice of 24 August 2026?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who already applied against the Advertisement/Circular Notice dated 24.08.2026 need not apply again.
